# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 01-auth (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev (fresh RS256 JWT keypair)
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 01-auth uses only these:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 04_Redis 05_Kafka 06_RabbitMQ 07_Elastic_APM 10_RustFS.
# Other blocks are ignored — including 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), which is the
# search/review business ES used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review.
#
# auth is the SOLE holder of the RS256 private key: init-env.sh GENERATES a fresh
# keypair + INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN on every run (no JWT keys in this file, and NO
# ### Auth_Identity block — auth mints what every other service consumes).

### 01_PostgreSQL
   endpoint       postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/postgres
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

# --- 03 (:9201) is the SEARCH/REVIEW business ES — used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review.
#     01-auth does NOT read it; the auth log-sink ES is block 07's `elasticsearch` (:9200). ---
### 03_Elasticsearch
   endpoint       http://<user>:<password>@<host>:9201
   host:port      <host>:9201
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 04_Redis
   endpoint       redis://default:<password>@<host>:6379/0
   host:port      <host>:6379
   user           default
   password       <password>

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092
   ui             http://<host>:8080
   auth           none (PLAINTEXT)

### 06_RabbitMQ
   amqp-url       amqp://<user>:<password>@<host>:5672/
   host:port      <host>:5672
   user           <user>
   password       <password>
   ui             http://<host>:15672

# --- 07's `elasticsearch` line (:9200) is the APM-stack ES = the application log sink for
#     01-auth (and every non-search/review service); `apm-ingest` (:8200) is APM traces. ---
### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<apm-es-password>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-bearer-token>
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   <apm-es-password>
   kibana_system  <kibana-system-password>

### 10_RustFS
   s3-endpoint    http://<host>:9002
   console-ui     http://<host>:9001
   access-key     <access-key>
   secret-key     <secret-key>
